services.name: General Consultations

services.name: In-House Dispensing Pharmacy
services.description: Prescriptions from your consultation dispensed on the spot — so you can head straight home after your visit.

testimonials.name: Miriam K.
testimonials.text: The doctor sat down and explained my son's results step by step, then wrote down what to do next. I left knowing exactly what was happening.

testimonials.name: Robert S.
testimonials.text: I came in as a walk-in on a Saturday morning and was seen within the hour. Lab results were ready before I left the building.

testimonials.name: Grace A.
testimonials.text: My ante-natal visits have been calm and thorough. The nurses are patient with questions and the reminder messages mean I never miss one.
